name: Oskar Pajka
headline: Software Developer and Motion Designer
summary: Programming student who builds full-stack web applications in TypeScript, React and Next.js, with automated tests and containerised deployment from the first commit. Also produces launch films for software products in After Effects. Looking for a software internship or part-time role, available remotely alongside school.

projects.name: Slotwise
projects.kind: Booking and SMS reminder app for small businesses
points: Designing and building a self-hosted web app for a business owner to manage clients, services and appointments, with SMS confirmations and reminders.
Implemented password sign-in with required two-factor authentication (authenticator app and backup codes) using Better Auth.
Set up Docker Compose deployment with automatic database migrations, and a CI pipeline running unit, integration and end-to-end tests (Vitest, Playwright).

projects.name: framecatch
projects.kind: Open-source screenshot and screen recording tool for Windows
points: Co-developing with a second developer: hotkey-driven region and full-screen capture that saves straight to the desktop; screen recording in progress.
Work through pull requests with code review on every change and agreed branch and commit conventions.

projects.name: oskarpajka.com
points: Designed and built a static bilingual site with a custom video player, deployed automatically from GitHub, with no tracking scripts or cookies.

projects.name: Hoplite launch film
points: Rebuilt the product's interface for animation and produced a 32-second 4K film, including sound design.

projects.name: BridgeMind launch film
points: Produced a 30-second film in square and vertical cuts, rebuilding the BridgeSpace and BridgeVoice interface.

awards.title: Laureate (one of 26), 5th Świętokrzyskie Province Computer Science Competition for primary schools

languages.level: C1, preparing for Cambridge C1 Advanced
